mediatypeid.description:
ID of the media type.

Property behavior:
- read-only
- required for update operations

exec_path.description:
Name of the script file (e.g., notification.sh) that is located in the directory specified in the AlertScriptsPath server configuration parameter.

Property behavior:
- required if type is set to "Script"

gsm_modem.description:
Serial device name of the GSM modem.

Property behavior:
- required if type is set to "SMS"

passwd.description:
Authentication password.

Property behavior:
- supported if smtp_authentication is set to "Normal password"

smtp_email.description:
Email address from which notifications will be sent.

Property behavior:
- required if type is set to "Email"

smtp_helo.description:
SMTP HELO.

Property behavior:
- supported if type is set to "Email"

smtp_server.description:
SMTP server.

Property behavior:
- required if type is set to "Email"

smtp_port.description:
SMTP server port to connect to.

Default: 25.

Property behavior:
- supported if type is set to "Email"

smtp_security.description:
SMTP connection security level to use.

Possible values:
0 - (default) None;
1 - STARTTLS;
2 - SSL/TLS.

Property behavior:
- supported if type is set to "Email"

smtp_verify_host.description:
SSL verify host for SMTP.

Possible values:
0 - (default) No;
1 - Yes.

Property behavior:
- supported if smtp_security is set to "STARTTLS" or "SSL/TLS"

smtp_verify_peer.description:
SSL verify peer for SMTP.

Possible values:
0 - (default) No;
1 - Yes.

Property behavior:
- supported if smtp_security is set to "STARTTLS" or "SSL/TLS"

smtp_authentication.description:
SMTP authentication method to use.

Possible values:
0 - (default) None;
1 - Normal password.

Property behavior:
- supported if type is set to "Email"

status.description:
Whether the media type is enabled.

Possible values:
0 - (default) Enabled;
1 - Disabled.

username.description:
User name.

Property behavior:
- supported if smtp_authentication is set to "Normal password"

maxsessions.description:
The maximum number of alerts that can be processed in parallel.

Possible values if type is set to "SMS": 1.

Possible values if type is set to "Email", "Script", or "Webhook": 0-100.

Default: 1.

maxattempts.description:
The maximum number of attempts to send an alert.

Possible values: 1-100.

Default: 3.

attempt_interval.description:
The interval between retry attempts.
Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix.

Possible values: 0-1h.

Default: 10s.

content_type.description:
Deprecated. Please use message_format instead.
Message format.

Possible values:
0 - Plain text;
1 - (default) HTML.

Property behavior:
- supported if type is set to "Email"

message_format.description:
Message format.

Possible values:
0 - Plain text;
1 - (default) HTML.

Property behavior:
- supported if type is set to "Email"

script.description:
Webhook script body (JavaScript).

Property behavior:
- required if type is set to "Webhook"

timeout.description:
Webhook script timeout.
Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix.

Possible values: 1-60s.

Default: 30s.

Property behavior:
- supported if type is set to "Webhook"

process_tags.description:
Process JSON property values in Webhook script response as tags. These tags are added to any existing problem tags.

Possible values:
0 - (default) Ignore webhook script response;
1 - Process webhook script response as tags.

Property behavior:
- supported if type is set to "Webhook"

show_event_menu.description:
Include an entry in the event menu that links to a custom URL. Also adds the urls property to the output of problem.get and event.get.

Possible values:
0 - (default) Do not include event menu entry or urls property;
1 - Include event menu entry and urls property.

Property behavior:
- supported if type is set to "Webhook"

event_menu_url.description:
URL used in the event menu entry and in the urls property returned by problem.get and event.get.

Property behavior:
- supported if show_event_menu is set to "Include event menu entry and urls property"

event_menu_name.description:
Name used for the event menu entry and in the urls property returned by problem.get and event.get.

Property behavior:
- supported if show_event_menu is set to "Include event menu entry and urls property"

parameters.description:
Webhook or script parameters.

Property behavior:
- supported if type is set to "Webhook" or "Script"

sortorder.description:
The order in which parameter values will be passed to the script as command-line arguments, starting with 0 as the first one.

Property behavior:
- required

message_templates.description: Message templates to replace the current message templates.

recovery.description:
Operation mode.

Possible values:
0 - Operations;
1 - Recovery operations;
2 - Update operations.

Property behavior:
- required
